description: Angular component for managing a list of filter predicates, including adding, removing, and editing complex filter predicates via dialogs.

classes.name: FilterPredicateListComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for a list of filter predicates, supporting complex predicate editing via dialogs.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and subscribes to value changes to update the model.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the predicates in the form, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: addPredicate
methods.description: Adds a new predicate, opening a dialog if complex predicate is selected.

methods.name: removePredicate
methods.description: Removes a predicate at a specified index.

methods.name: openComplexFilterDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog for editing complex filter predicates and returns the result as an observable.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the external model with current predicates.
